title: Murderhost of Halfa vs Kishomon Company
lede: The Murderhost of Halfa beat the Kishomon Company 36-24 in Battle Round 6, holding the centre objective at the end of every round and the east in five of six. The Murderhost's Round 2 charge broke all three Ashigaru squads off their ground; Kishomon's only steady score was the west objective, held from Round 2 by an Armored Gashadokuro that never took an action.
result_line: Murderhost of Halfa win 36-24 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6
deployment:
Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, objectives at the centre (7,7), the west (1,7) and the east (13,7). The Murderhost of Halfa lined rows 12 and 13 with ten units: Cultist Zealots 3 and 2 and Hounds of Satan 1 on the west, the Cultist Troopers, Furyforged Berserkers 1 with The Blooded Hegemon and Cultist Zealots 1 in the middle, the Avatar of Wrath, Furyforged Berserkers 2 and Hounds of Satan 2 to the east. The Kishomon Company put the Kitsune Shinobi HIDDEN at (1,3), the Tsuchigumo Gun Battery at (3,1), the Armored Gashadokuro at (5,1), Ashigaru Riflemen 2, 3 and 1 (with the War Onmyoji) across row 2, the Oni Samurai with the Taichou at (11,2), and three Shikigami Tokens in the corner for the War Onmyoji's Paper Body. With fewer units, Kishomon had Priority every round.

The Murderhost is a melee army with no ranged threat to speak of; Kishomon's plan was to hold ground with rifles and let the Oni Samurai and the gun do the killing.

1.title: The Kitsune Shinobi run into the Zealots

feed.text: Kishomon spent 1 Regalia on YATA NO KAGAMI, marking five Murderhost units for +1 AP, and 3 CP (with the range surcharge) on Double Time for the Kitsune Shinobi, which bought nothing.

The Kitsune Shinobi moved first, to (6,6) beside the centre, and lost HIDDEN when Cultist Zealots 1 charged them at (7,7). Hounds of Satan 2 took the east at (13,7) with the Avatar of Wrath behind; the Cultist Troopers and Hounds of Satan 1 filled the centre. The Ashigaru stopped short at rows 5 and 6.
The Tsuchigumo Gun Battery hit the Cultist Troopers for 6. Cultist Zealots 1 rolled 21 dice at the Kitsune Shinobi, got 7 hits and destroyed them, then took ground at (6,6).
The Murderhost held the centre (OC 12 vs 0) and the east (OC 7 vs 0) for 5 VP; Kishomon scored nothing. 5-0.

2.title: The great charge, and Kusanagi no Tsurugi answers

feed.text: The Murderhost's 3 CP Secure Objective on Cultist Zealots 2 bought nothing. Kishomon held its CP.

Eight Murderhost units charged. Cultist Zealots 3, Furyforged Berserkers 1 and Hounds of Satan 2 hit the three Ashigaru squads, and all three failed their Fall Back tests and broke away in disorder for 2, 2 and 3 True Damage; Furyforged Berserkers 2, both Cultist Zealots squads, Hounds of Satan 1 and the Avatar of Wrath charged them again where they landed. The Oni Samurai and the Taichou charged Hounds of Satan 2 and Cultist Zealots 3 at (9,6).

Kishomon spent 3 Regalia on KUSANAGI NO TSURUGI at (7,6): 20 HP off five Murderhost units and six units PARALYZED, The Blooded Hegemon among them. The Oni Samurai then destroyed Cultist Zealots 3 (14 damage). The Murderhost still won the exchange: Cultist Zealots 1 did 18 to Ashigaru Riflemen 1 and destroyed it, Furyforged Berserkers 2 did 16 to Ashigaru Riflemen 2, and Cultist Zealots 2 struck the War Onmyoji twice, each time killing a Shikigami Token in its place through Paper Body.

The Murderhost kept the centre (OC 5 vs 0) for 3 and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1 for the Avatar standing in the east, where Ashigaru Riflemen 3 held on (OC 4 vs 2). The Armored Gashadokuro took the west alone. Kishomon scored 4 objective VP and 1 of STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION. 9-5.

3.title: ASSASSINATION, COMMAND AUTHORITY, and a capped 10

feed.text: Kishomon bought a fresh Ashigaru Riflemen squad with Troop Requisition (5 CP) at (7,2). The Murderhost's 2 CP Double Time on Cultist Zealots 1, in Kishomon's half, completed COMMAND AUTHORITY for 2 VP.
The Oni Samurai and the Taichou charged again at (8,6). Hounds of Satan 2 broke away in disorder; Hounds of Satan 1 and Furyforged Berserkers 1 fell back.

The Oni Samurai destroyed Furyforged Berserkers 2. Cultist Zealots 1 caught the War Onmyoji again: Paper Body spent the last Shikigami Token, and the second blow killed it, for ASSASSINATION and 4 VP. The Tsuchigumo hit the Cultist Troopers for 4.

The Murderhost held the centre (OC 8 vs 7) and took the east back (OC 7 vs 3): 3 VP and 1 of 2, plus the two secondaries, made 10. The cap withheld the other east VP and all 3 of BREAK THEIR HOLD. Because a Primary that earned VP its cap held back counts as scoring, Kishomon's STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid nothing; the Gashadokuro's west objective paid 2. 19-7.

4.title: The Oni Samurai, enchanted, kill Furyforged Berserkers 1

feed.text: The Murderhost bought Cultist Troopers #2 with Troop Requisition (3 CP). Kishomon's 2 CP Double Time on its new Ashigaru Riflemen bought nothing.

Kishomon spent 2 Regalia on YASAKANI NO MAGATAMA for the Oni Samurai (+2 AR, +2 FR, +1 DMG, +1 AP), which charged into the centre at (8,7). Furyforged Berserkers 1 and The Blooded Hegemon charged at (7,6), Cultist Zealots 2 at (8,5).

The Oni Samurai destroyed Furyforged Berserkers 1 (8 damage); the Hegemon put 3 into the Taichou. The Avatar of Wrath did 10 to the requisitioned Ashigaru Riflemen, and Cultist Zealots 2 finished Ashigaru Riflemen 2.

The Murderhost held the centre (OC 8 vs 7) and the east (level at OC 5 each, and the Murderhost's on the tiebreak) for 5 VP, but BREAK THEIR HOLD scored nothing, so STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid Kishomon its full 3, with the west 2 more. 24-12.
Kishomon's 2 CP Double Time took Ashigaru Riflemen 3 to (8,8), a move out of reach without it; the Murderhost spent 2 CP on Rally Cry for Hounds of Satan 2.
Cultist Zealots 1 and both Hounds squads charged into the centre, where Ashigaru Riflemen 3 had arrived; Cultist Zealots 2 broke away in disorder for 3 True Damage.

Cultist Zealots 1 destroyed Ashigaru Riflemen 3, and the Oni Samurai did 8 to the Zealots in return. The Blooded Hegemon and Hounds of Satan 2 took 6 HP off the Oni Samurai. The Tsuchigumo did 6 to Cultist Troopers #2.

Centre and east for the Murderhost again, 5 VP, and nothing from BREAK THEIR HOLD. Kishomon took 2 from the west, 2 from STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION and 3 for DEEP REACH, which the Gashadokuro's west objective completed. 29-19.

6.title: The Hegemon finishes the Oni Samurai

feed.text: Both sides spent 2 CP on Rally Cry, the Murderhost for Hounds of Satan 2 and Kishomon for the Oni Samurai; Kishomon's last 2 Regalia put YASAKANI NO MAGATAMA on the Taichou.
Hounds of Satan 1 and Cultist Zealots 2 charged into Kishomon's half at (8,6) and (9,6).

The Blooded Hegemon destroyed the Oni Samurai, and Cultist Zealots 2 killed the Taichou. Cultist Troopers #2's Desperate Worship cost it 2 HP for +1 FR against the Armored Gashadokuro, which saved all 6 hits. Attacks on three different units in Kishomon's half completed PROBING STRIKE for 2.
The centre (OC 11 vs 3) and the east (OC 5 vs 0) gave the Murderhost 5 more, 7 with PROBING STRIKE, and 36 passed the target. Kishomon's west and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION made 5. 36-24.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Murderhost of Halfa's 36 was objectives (27), secondaries (8: ASSASSINATION 4, COMMAND AUTHORITY 2, PROBING STRIKE 2) and BREAK THEIR HOLD (1, with 3 more withheld by the cap in Round 3). The Kishomon Company's 24 was objectives (12, ten of them from the west), STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION (9) and DEEP REACH (3). The Murderhost held the centre at the end of all six rounds and the east in five.

{{chart:objectives}}

The charge that won it

The battle turned in Round 2. Eight Murderhost units charged, every Ashigaru squad failed its Fall Back test, and by the end of the round Ashigaru Riflemen 1 was gone and Ashigaru Riflemen 2 was down to 2 HP. KUSANAGI NO TSURUGI was Kishomon's best answer, 20 HP and six units PARALYZED, and the Oni Samurai (36 damage, 3 kills, the most on the table) kept killing for four rounds, but Kishomon never again had the bodies to contest the centre. Cultist Zealots 1 (10 RP) was the Murderhost's best unit: 31 damage, 4 kills, ASSASSINATION and COMMAND AUTHORITY.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

Kishomon's two engines

Kishomon scored from two places. The Armored Gashadokuro (55 RP) stood in the west from Round 2 to the end and spent no APt in any of the six rounds, with no legal action each time, yet the scoring record gives it 17.5 VP, the most of any unit: all 10 west objective VP hinged on it, and it carried STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION and DEEP REACH. That is a holding unit doing its job; no Murderhost unit entered the west Objective Area after Round 3. The other was STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION, which paid 2 VP in every round the Murderhost's BREAK THEIR HOLD scored nothing. From Round 4 the Murderhost had no unit in an objective Kishomon controlled, so its Primary was dead and fed Kishomon's.

AI notes

Commands were the weak spot on both sides: Kishomon's Round 1 Double Time (3 CP) on the Kitsune Shinobi, which then died, and its Round 4 Double Time both bought nothing, as did the Murderhost's Round 2 Secure Objective (3 CP). The Murderhost never sent a unit to the west, which would have both contested Kishomon's only objective and revived BREAK THEIR HOLD. Its Mana grew to 51 from Tithe of Torment and was never spent: no unit in this preset casts. That is the army, not the AI.

{{chart:attrition}}

Against the first playing

The first playing was a 30-27 Murderhost win, also in Round 6, and much closer. Then BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Murderhost 10 VP and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION paid Kishomon 4; this time BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1 and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 9, because Kishomon held only the west from Round 3 and the Murderhost never went there. The Murderhost added a Cultist Troopers squad and The Blooded Hegemon cost 60 RP instead of 70; Kishomon's Tsuchigumo Gun Battery dropped from 35 to 26 RP and its Oni Samurai and Kitsune Shinobi went up. Tithe of Torment, new since then, gave the Murderhost 51 Mana it had no use for.

closing: The Murderhost of Halfa did what a melee army has to: closed in Round 2, broke the rifle line and sat on the middle of the board. Kishomon's Regalia and Oni Samurai made it costly, and a Gashadokuro on the west kept the score respectable, but the Ashigaru never got back to the centre.
